_comment: Click-band alias-audit baseline. REFRESHED 2026-09-23 for the drawn volume network (user volume is now the pot between preamp and power amp, so the canonical stimulus at vol 0.5 drives the amp ~14 dB less than the pre-2026-09-23 pinned drive). Previously refreshed 2026-09-13 (pickup corner 2312 -> 880 Hz) and captured at v0.5.1. Generated by `preamp-bench alias-audit --note <n> --velocity 120 --json` at 44.1 kHz host rate. Refresh rationale: max_step_up_db rose +3.83 dB (note 84) and +2.02 dB (note 91) while hf_band_dbc is UNCHANGED (within 0.25 dB) on every note; and a volume sweep (--volume 0.5/0.75/1.0) brings note 84's step_up back to 1.52 at vol 1.0, where the drive matches the old pinned value. That pattern is the amp's crossover residual being proportionally larger at lower drive, not fold-back: a real alias regression moves both metrics the same way. h1_dbfs fell ~15 dB on every note (lower drive plus the 4.5 dB post-speaker gain removed).
